items.headline: Chase Clout banned again, 41 minutes into a "comeback stream"
items.body: Chat says it was the third "chat, chat, CHAT" in a row that did it. His mom says he's "taking a break." His sponsors say nothing, loudly.

items.headline: Dunk Daniels late to his own jersey retirement
items.body: The ceremony started without him. He arrived in time for dessert and got a standing ovation, mostly for the dessert.

items.headline: Chardonnay Shade throws a drink at Velvet Static, then orders another
items.body: Witnesses describe it as "an emotional pinot." Her spin-off pitch deck reportedly includes the receipt. Mags the bartender declined to comment, then commented.

items.headline: Ask Lola: "He only texts me after midnight"
items.body: "Hon, that's not a situationship, that's a night shift. A man who wants to see you can find you at 2 PM. Put the phone on Do Not Disturb, wear the good jacket to brunch, and let him wonder." Lola Lowdown

items.headline: Lunaria drops a surprise album at 3 AM; three producers post "no comment"
items.body: Track 7 is just the word "no," sung for four minutes. Critics are calling it her best work. The producers are calling their lawyers.

items.headline: Brock Squarejaw cast as a superhero (in a cereal commercial)
items.body: He did his own stunts. The stunt was eating the cereal. His agent calls it "a stepping stone." The cereal calls it a good week.

items.headline: Skyler Beta launches her eleventh app
items.body: It tells you which of her other apps are working. It is down. A spokesperson says the outage is "a feature, for focus."

items.headline: Peyton Pastel's apology video goes viral; the original controversy is still unclear
items.body: Four million views and counting. Commenters agree she's "so sorry." Nobody agrees about what. Her pastel ring light got its own fan account.

items.headline: Brick Tackleton lands a dramatic role; early reviews call his crying "structurally sound"
items.body: The film is about a lighthouse keeper. Brick says he "became the lighthouse." His teammates say he's been standing very still in the locker room.

items.headline: DJ Polaroid plays to a sold-out crowd of nine
items.body: Hellgate Hall confirms all nine were DJ Polaroid's cousins. "It still counts," says DJ Polaroid. Rocco the bouncer says he checked everyone's ID, "for the vibe."

items.headline: Chad Kensington, CEO, closes a C$0 "pre-seed" round
items.body: He calls it "pre-pre-seed." Investors call it "a guy at Grind & Gossip." Jojo the barista says he has been nursing the same latte since Tuesday.
